full_name: Qimiao (Frank) Si | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Physical Sciences Edward, Frances, and Shirley B. Daniels Fellow Rice University
bio: Qimiao (Frank) Si, director of the Extreme Quantum Materials Alliance at Rice University, is a physicist who studies how vast numbers of electrons collectively organize in solids to produce new forms of matter with emergent properties.
